request.style: English, warm country gospel, heartfelt female vocal, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, piano, brushed drums, gentle and grateful, 82 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Out in the desert every morning there was bread upon the ground
Thin and flaky, fine as frost, and not a soul went without
Even when they grumbled and they turned their hearts around
Every single morning there was manna to be found

[Chorus]
The LORD's acts of mercy never cease
His compassions never come to an end
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
LORD, your mercy reaches to the heavens
Your faithfulness to the clouds

[Verse]
Peter swore he'd never leave him, but he warmed his hands that night
By a fire in the courtyard he denied him three times
Then beside the lake one morning, in the early light so pale
Three times he asked him, Do you love me, and his mercy did not fail

[Chorus]
The LORD's acts of mercy never cease
His compassions never come to an end
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
LORD, your mercy reaches to the heavens
Your faithfulness to the clouds

[Bridge]
If we are faithless, he remains faithful
For he cannot deny himself
If we are faithless, he remains faithful
For he cannot deny himself

[Outro]
They are new every morning
Great is your faithfulness
